register.labelZh: PLUG 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: plug away 可以描述某人即使需要很長時間,仍然努力完成工作。；plug something in 和 plug something into something 適合用來說明如何接駁打印機、屏幕、燈和其他設備。；plug in 和 plug into something 可以用來詢問或說明電視、電線或其他設備應接駁在哪裏。；plug something up 可以描述堵住孔洞和縫隙,以阻擋風、水或昆蟲。
register.summaryEn: Plug away describes someone continuing to work hard even when a task takes a long time. Plug something in and plug something into something are useful when setting up printers, screens, lights and other equipment. Plug in and plug into something help you ask or explain where a television, cable or other device connects. Plug something up can describe blocking holes and gaps to keep out wind, water or insects.
